primary.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
primary.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.summary: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned models by adding their task vectors to a shared backbone. We show that a first-order directional derivative of task A's outputs along task B's vector can predict interference, but only when evaluated at the appropriate model. primary.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
primary.summary: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a press conference Friday following his summit with China President Xi Jinping and Russia President Vladimir Putin.
